column1: IN-0863,atteso: NO (QID di MBDA Italia),Is 'MBDA España S.L.' the same legal entity as 'MBDA Italia S.p.A.'? Does MBDA España S.L. have its own Wikidata item?,"NO. MBDA España S.L. and MBDA Italia S.p.A. are distinct legal entities that function as separate components of the MBDA group [1][2]. Official corporate documentation defines the MBDA group as a collective formed by individual entities, including MBDA España and MBDA Italia [3][1]. MBDA España is registered in Madrid with its own tax identification number (B86093689) [4][5], while MBDA Italia operates as a separate entity based in Rome [3]. Regarding Wikidata, no search results provided confirm the existence of a specific Wikidata item for MBDA España S.L.","SUSTAINABILITY

IN-0599,sospetto: NO (controllata di Damen),"Is 'Damen Naval' (Netherlands) the same legal entity as 'Damen Shipyards Group' (Damen Group), or a separate company within the group?","NO. Damen Naval is a division of the Damen Shipyards Group rather than a separate legal entity [1][2]. According to official company information, Damen Naval functions as the dedicated naval shipbuilding division that consolidates the group's naval activities [1][3]. Regulatory records confirm that the business originally known as Koninklijke Schelde Groep was acquired by the Damen Shipyards Group in 2000 and integrated into its corporate structure [4]. The group’s official sustainability reporting and organizational documentation consistently categorize Damen Naval as one of several divisions operating under the broader Damen Shipyards Group umbrella [5][2].","New Era, New Name: Damen Naval - Securing Our Seas - Damen

IN-1019,sospetto: NO (QID di Safran Aircraft Engines),Is 'Safran AI' (the artificial intelligence unit of the Safran group) the same legal entity as 'Safran Aircraft Engines'?,"NO. Safran.AI and Safran Aircraft Engines are distinct legal entities within the Safran group.

Safran.AI (formerly Preligens) is a subsidiary of Safran Electronics & Defense [1][2][3]. In contrast, Safran Aircraft Engines is a separate tier-one operating company within the Safran group's Propulsion division [4][5]. While both operate under the Safran umbrella, they have different organizational alignments and distinct operational roles [4][5].","Safran.AI - Leader in artificial intelligence for aerospace and defense

IN-1352,controllo: Exa aveva sbagliato nel pilota,"Is 'Alcoa Warrick LLC' (Delaware, Warrick Operations in Indiana) the same legal entity as Alcoa Corporation, or a separate subsidiary or site? Who owns it today?","NO. Alcoa Warrick LLC is not the same legal entity as Alcoa Corporation; it was sold by Alcoa Corporation as a distinct entity in 2021. Alcoa’s SEC 8-K says it completed the disposition of “Alcoa Warrick LLC” to Kaiser Aluminum on March 31, 2021 [1]. Kaiser’s press release and SEC filing also state Kaiser completed acquisition of Alcoa Warrick LLC from Alcoa Corporation [2][3]. Therefore, ownership today is by Kaiser Aluminum (Kaiser Aluminum acquired Alcoa Warrick LLC in 2021) [2][1].","Alcoa Corp Form 8-K filed April 6, 2021

IN-1014,controllo positivo: SI (stessa societa),"Are 'Saab Aktiebolag' and 'Saab Group' the same company (Saab AB, Swedish defence and security company)?","YES. Saab Aktiebolag and Saab AB are the same legal entity, and the term Saab Group is used to refer to the company and its subsidiaries [1][2][3]. Official documentation from the Swedish Bolagsverket identifies the company by its registered name, Saab Aktiebolag, and its registration number 556036-0793 [4]. The company’s own filings interchangeably use Saab AB and Saab Aktiebolag to describe the parent company, while defining the Saab Group as the parent company and its consolidated subsidiaries [1][5][3].","Keeping people and society safe
